title: Annotatio II §.VI: Hunnius urges embracing the opinion of Fathers older than Augustine
pass_a_gloss: and he urged that the opinion of the Fathers older than Augustine was to be embraced.
pass_b_english: He pressed for taking up the view held by the Fathers who came before Augustine.
source_text: & Patrum Augustino antiquiorum opinionem amplectendam suasit.

lemmas.gloss: of the Fathers older than Augustine
urged that the opinion be embraced

notes: Hexades Annotatio II §.VI densify §190; Hunnius pre-Augustinian turn.
